6.314 rsVariableInDataRegionOrDataSetFilterExpression
rsVariableInDataRegionOrDataSetFilterExpression is a critical error that will occur when a
Filter.FilterValues or Filter.FilterExpression within Chart.Filters, GaugePanel.Filters, Tablix.Filters, or
DataSet.Filters references a Variable via the Variables global collection.
